hook.line: I'm an AI engineer at Google and this is what scares me about AI.
hook.visual: Selfie close-up in a sunlit car under a glass roof, a fixed 'scared of AI' label at the top and a typewriter caption with a cursor near her chin.

beats.what: Credential plus fear in one sentence, typed out as she speaks
Jump cut to a tighter frame for reason one: AI deployed faster than its failure modes are understood
Finger count gesture for reason two: policy makers have never built a model
Jump cut for reason three: AI sounds right without being right
Reframe and quick head move for reason four: today's behavioural data trains future models
Specific dates: 2026 blind spots baked into 2034 models
Camera tilts, wide frame showing the car roof as she softens into 'I do believe in AI'
Cuts off mid-sentence, which loops back to the opening

why_it_works: Insider credential plus a fear in the first sentence, so the viewer expects information others don't have
Numbered reasons ('the first thing', 'the second thing') tell the viewer there is a list to finish
Big face (median height 0.385) in a casual car setting reads as an honest, unscripted aside
weaknesses: No visuals support the points; every reason is told, none shown
All text sits outside the safe area (share 1.0), so TikTok UI can cover captions
No CTA despite a strong opinion that invites comments
for_robert: Open with his credential and a feeling in one line ('I build X and this worries me'); a mascot could hold up a finger-count sign for each numbered reason.
